blurb: Anchors Away Charters offers inshore, nearshore, and offshore fishing charters targeting species like snook, redfish, trout, grouper, snapper, and kingfish. They also provide boat cruises to Cabbage Key island, sunset cruises, sandbar trips, and dolphin tours. Trips are customized for all skill levels and group sizes, led by a USCG licensed captain with over 40 years of experience.
